from pathlib import Path
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import subprocess, threading, json, hashlib
# HEB154_OFFLINE_LAUNCHER_CANARY_5c174
root=Path('/Users/thaffey/Documents/Haffey Enterprises/Working/HEB-154-2026-09-29/integration')
out=root/'stdin-diagnosis'
terms=[s.strip() for s in Path('/Users/thaffey/Documents/Haffey Enterprises/config/exclude-terms').read_text().splitlines() if s.strip() and not s.lstrip().startswith('#')]
requests=[]
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*args): pass
    def do_POST(self):
        raw=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
        body=json.loads(raw)
        requests.append({'path':self.path,'body_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'messages':body.get('messages',[])})
        data=json.dumps({'type':'error','error':{'type':'invalid_request_error','message':'Offline capture completed; no model invoked.'}}).encode()
        self.send_response(400); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(data))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(data)
server=HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler)
thread=threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever,daemon=True); thread.start()
cli=root/'claude-minimum/node_modules/.bin/claude'
env={'HOME':str(out),'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin','ANTHROPIC_API_KEY':'offline-synthetic-placeholder','ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL':f'http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}','CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR':str(out/'wire-host'),'CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC':'1'}
rows=[]
for mode in ('inherited-regular-eof','devnull'):
    requests.clear()
    command=['/usr/bin/sandbox-exec','-p','(version 1)(allow default)(deny network*)(allow network-outbound (remote ip "localhost:*"))',str(cli),'--bare','--print','--tools','','--model','haiku','--max-budget-usd','0.06','--no-session-persistence','--output-format','json','HEB154_APPROVED_ARGV_CANARY']
    try:
        r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,cwd=out,capture_output=True,text=True,stdin=None if mode=='inherited-regular-eof' else subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=30)
        row={'mode':mode,'returncode':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr}
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        row={'mode':mode,'timeout':True,'stdout':str(exc.stdout),'stderr':str(exc.stderr)}
    row['requests']=list(requests)
    data=json.dumps(row,indent=2)
    for term in terms: data=data.replace(term,'Haffey Enterprises')
    (out/('text-wire-v2-'+mode+'.json')).write_text(data+'\n')
    message_text=json.dumps([r['messages'] for r in requests])
    summary={'mode':mode,'request_count':len(requests),'launcher_source_present':'from pathlib import Path' in message_text,'argv_canary_present':'HEB154_APPROVED_ARGV_CANARY' in message_text,'returncode':row.get('returncode'),'timeout':row.get('timeout',False)}
    rows.append(summary); print(json.dumps(summary),flush=True)
server.shutdown(); server.server_close()
(out/'text-wire-v2-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
